node.statement: Assembly, involution, and unit. For each n let pi_j=I_n tensor Pi_j and define X_jk=pi_j X pi_k, mu_n(X)=(X_jk), Gamma_n=(gamma_jk,n), alpha_n((Y_jk))=sum_jk Y_jk, and gamma_n=alpha_n Gamma_n mu_n. Exact source complementarity gives X=sum_jk X_jk and shows that gamma_n=I_n tensor gamma_1 for the single level-one map gamma_1(X)=sum_jk gamma_jk(Pi_j X Pi_k). The involution clause of def-four-corner-merging-datum gives gamma_n(X^dagger)=gamma_n(X)^dagger exactly. Its two diagonal-unit bounds and ||P_1+P_2-I||<=rho give ||gamma_n(I)-I||<=3rho (with I meaning the matrix-level unit), uniformly in n.
